eps.o: NXT goes Hollywood to ring in 2025 with New Year's Evil from Los Angeles. NXT Champion Trick Williams defends in a Triple Threat Match.
OTM challenge Fraxiom for the NXT Tag Team Title. Lash Legend & Jakara Jackson collide with The Unholy Union in a No. 1 Contender's Match
NXT Champion Oba Femi faces his first challenger in Eddy Thorpe. Tony D'Angelo takes on Ridge Holland with the NXT North American Title on the line.
NXT takes center stage in Atlanta. Lash Legend & Jakara Jackson challenge Bianca Belair & Naomi for the WWE Women's Tag Team Championship
NXT Champion Oba Femi & Trick Williams battle A-Town Down Under. NXT Women's Champion Giulia, Bayley and Roxanne Perez meet in a Vengeance Day Summit.
Tony D'Angelo and Ridge Holland collide in a Steel Cage Match for the NXT North American Title. TNA's JDC looks to take Lexis King's NXT Heritage Cup.
The hottest free agent signs his NXT contract. Stacks seeks retribution for "The Don" Tony D'Angelo as he takes on Shawn Spears.
NXT's newest signing Ricky Saints teams with Je'Von Evans to combat Ethan Page and Wes Lee. Cincinnati's own Lexis King challenges TNA's Moose.
Shawn Spears aims to begin his takeover of NXT by attempting to dethrone NXT North American Champion Tony D'Angelo.
Giulia and Stephanie Vaquer collide in a Title vs. Title Match at The Theater at MSG in New York City. TNA's Moose challenges NXT Champion Oba Femi.
Trick Williams and Eddy Thorpe throw down in NXT Underground. Sol Ruca challenges Chelsea Green for the WWE Women's United States Title.
Stephanie Vaquer pulls double duty defending the NXT Women's Title against Jaida Parker and the NXT Women's North American Title versus Fallon Henley.

Trick Williams is getting back to the business of being on top, and that means calling out current NXT Champion Oba Femi for a meeting in the ring. Elsewhere, Ricky Saints will be challenging for his first championship under the WWE umbrella when he takes on Shawn Spears for the North American title. Plus, Stephanie Vaquer has challengers coming from all sides for both of her titles, the tag…

NXT Champion Oba Femi will have to team up the two men who will challenge for his title at Stand & Deliver, Trick Williams & Je’Von Evans, against the invading DarkState in a six-man tag team match. Elsewhere, Jordynne Grace takes on Jaida Parker while the two jockey for position in the women’s title picture, more qualifiers for the women’s North American championship ladder match, Ricky Saints…
Giulia & Roxanne make it official, Tony D looks over his shoulder, and Trick Williams says his name on this week’s NXT.
NXT walks with Elijah, Myles Borne is a made man, and Jordynne Grace reigns supreme on this week’s NXT.
Tony D’Angelo gets hustled, Fatal Influence gets their name in lights, and Myles Borne puts everything on the line on this week’s NXT.
Joe Hendry is live in concert while Trick Williams delivers a rap performance on the last NXT before Battleground. OTM return to take on Chase U.
NXT Champion Oba Femi meets his biggest challenger yet in Jasper Troy. Sean Legacy gets his chance at the NXT North American Championship.
NXT Superstars compete in four Eliminator Matches with huge WWE Evolution implications. "The Glamour" Blake Monroe signs her NXT contract.
Jordynne Grace, Lash Legend, Izzi Dame and Jaida Parker clash in an Evolution Eliminator Fatal 4-Way Match for an NXT Women's Title opportunity.
Yoshiki Inamura collides with Jasper Troy for an NXT Championship opportunity at Great American Bash. TNA's Joe Hendry squares off with Wes Lee.
Hank & Tank defend the NXT Tag Team Title against The Culling's Shawn Spears & Niko Vance. Ricky Saints competes in a grueling Gauntlet Match.
NXT Superstars clash in the wake of The Great American Bash. Tony D'Angelo, Stacks and Luca Crusifino collide in a Triple Threat Match.
The Undertaker comes to NXT in Houston after Trick Williams disrespected his LFG recruits. Oba Femi defends the NXT Title in a Triple Threat Match.

NXT Homecoming 2025 was a special event produced by World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE) that took place on September 16, 2025, at Full Sail University in Winter Park, Florida. The event marked NXT's return to its former home, celebrating the brand's origins and its long-standing partnership with Full Sail University.
